image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) curled up on a gray stone surface. The salamander displays the characteristic black and yellow warning coloration with irregular yellow spots and bands on a glossy black body. The salamander is positioned in a curved posture with its head visible on the right side and its tail wrapping around its body. The skin appears moist and glandular with a glossy texture. The background is a textured gray stone surface.
